generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The bidder shall have sufficient experience in Overhauling Works of Generator & its auxiliaries/ Mechanical Maintenance works of Turbine & its auxiliaries of 210MW and above capacity. As a proof of this, bidder shall upload the work order value not less than Rs 3.75 Lakhs (Excl. of GST) in a single work order issued by competent authority and relevant work done certificate issued by the competent authority in any one of the preceding 5 financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26).( On demand original shall be produced for verification.) Work done value of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year (Maximum 50% only) to bring them to the present price level of financial year in which tender is invited

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Single work order and its relevant work done certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The intended bidder shall be OEM/ OES/ Technical Service Agency. As a proof, the bidder shall furnish the Registration of Establishment / Firm / Company / Individual from Govt. Authority, Department of Labour

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registration of Establishment / Firm / Company / Individual from Govt. Authority, Department of Labour

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have achieved average annual financial turnover of Rs 7.50 Lakhs in any two of the preceding 5 financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26). The bidder shall submit the Profit and Loss account statement duly certified by chartered accountant which shall be enclosed as documentary evidence. (On demand original shall be produced for verification.) Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year (Maximum 50% only) to bring them to the present price level of financial year in which tender is invited.
